title: Name a set of commands
summary: Bash: Name a set of commands. Call greet with your name.
introduction: A function groups commands. $1 is its first input. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Name a set of commands with Bash

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.
The first function input becomes $1. printf inserts Ravi into the greeting.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Function inputs are positional; quote them when reading.
